title: Prepare and submit a public procurement bid
summary: When the company is considering a government or other formal tender opportunity. An authorized compliant submission or documented no-bid decision with obligations and evaluation follow-up assigned.
outcomes: An authorized compliant submission or documented no-bid decision with obligations and evaluation follow-up assigned.
guidance: Start with the applicability facts and evidence listed in the first step. Resolve missing facts before authorizing the affected work. Completion requires the documented outcome, including tracked exceptions; starting an application or recording a task is not evidence of completion.
when: When the company is considering a government or other formal tender opportunity.

parts.title: Extract the tender requirements and timetable
parts.guidance: Read the buyer-issued documents and amendments. Record eligibility, submission channel, evaluation criteria, required evidence and the stated deadline with its timezone.

references.title: UK SME and VCSE public procurement bid pack

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Approve a bid or no-bid decision
parts.guidance: The accountable owner reviews qualification, delivery capacity, commercial risk and conflicts. Obtain specialist interpretation for unfamiliar procurement rules and decline opportunities whose mandatory requirements cannot be met.

references.title: UK SME and VCSE public procurement bid pack

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Approve a bid or no-bid decision

parts.title: Assemble the evidence and response matrix
parts.guidance: Map each question and criterion to a specific response, supporting evidence and responsible reviewer. Mark missing certifications or references explicitly rather than making unsupported compliance claims.

references.title: UK SME and VCSE public procurement bid pack

execution.rationale: Prepare and reconcile local evidence; external action is separately approved.

parts.title: Review pricing commitments and declarations
parts.guidance: Authorized commercial and technical reviewers approve delivery promises, pricing assumptions and contractual departures. Check representations and required signatures against the actual company facts.

references.title: UK SME and VCSE public procurement bid pack

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

parts.title: Submit the approved bid through the buyer channel
parts.guidance: An authorized submitter uploads the approved version and retains the receipt and timestamp. Keep access credentials private and verify accepted submission status before the deadline.

references.title: UK SME and VCSE public procurement bid pack

execution.rationale: The named accountable person performs this decision, physical work or approved external operation; preparation does not authorize it.

approval.scope: Submit the approved bid through the buyer channel

parts.title: Manage clarification and award decisions
parts.guidance: The bid owner controls responses and records evaluation outcomes. A successful bid does not authorize signing an unreviewed contract; route awards and material amendments through their required approvals.
